purpose: Encode the long prompt; reuse history while generating
alt:
Optimized long-prompt prefill: Image + text → Causal encoder → Global KV sources → Local-state replay; Most prompt positions skip full decoder computation. Decoder local SWA state is approximate.
Generated-token computation: New token → Causal encoder → Decoder → Next-token logits; Generated tokens pass through both halves. Layer queries and SWA remain local even when global KV is shared.
caption: **Figure 1.** Read the prompt once, reuse its history while generating. Original schematic based on the reported optimized CED path, not a measured run.[^report]
